Title: Use of radar data for characterizing extreme precipitation at fine scales and short durations
Proposed Project Title: Probabilistic precipitation rate estimates from ground-radar for hydrology
Suggested Parent Project: Probabilistic precipitation rate estimates from ground-radar for hydrology
Authors / PI: Katharina Lengfeld; Pierre-Emmanuel Kirstetter; Hayley J Fowler; Jingjing Yu; Andreas Becker; Zachary Flamig; Jonathan Gourley
